In lisp 2033:

The error messages I get for FUNCALLing or LEXPR-FUNCALLing an array
on too few arguments is "TOO MANY ARGUMENTS SUPPLIED - APPLY".

Also the other stuff printed out in WNA error messages for FUNCALLing
or LEXPR-FUNCALLing an array varies from partly to completely bogus.
(The cases are too many to list them all, try them and see.)

Finally:

(LEXPR-FUNCALL (ARRAY NIL T 2 3) '(1 1 1))

gets an MPV.
